policy: Entries are evidence records, not automatic support claims. A device is supported only after exact-variant procedures and sources are reviewed.

known_limitations: No independently verified functional Ubuntu Touch port is recorded in this catalog.
Sony's product specification lists Android 7.0 at launch; the inspected handset reportedly runs Android 8.0 with Linux kernel 3.18.71. The exact firmware build and matching source must be identified.

Halium base cannot be selected from the chipset alone. Confirm the device's Android userspace, kernel source/configuration, partition layout, bootloader status, and availability of matching vendor blobs first.
